stage_skeptic.desc: Skeptic alone on stage, arms crossed, pointing/challenging (hook)

stage_skeptic2.desc: Skeptic alone on stage, asking the question (hook)

stage_both.desc: Skeptic and Friend on stage, Friend answering ("Fair question")

stage_both2.desc: Skeptic and Friend on stage, Friend answering

outro.desc: Skeptic says hm, then both on stage (ending + follow card)

jesus_crowd.desc: Jesus teaching people in a sunny meadow

jesus_sunset.desc: Jesus with a crowd at sunset, joyful, arms raised

garden_night.desc: Jesus praying alone at night in a garden (Gethsemane)

temple_night.desc: Temple courtyard with lamps, elders and Jesus

temple_day.desc: Jerusalem temple courtyard by day, leaders facing Jesus

manger.desc: Newborn Jesus in a manger with Mary and Joseph, warm light

house_child.desc: Young child Jesus with Mary in a house, visitors bowing

caravan_star.desc: Travellers with a camel crossing a desert at night under a star

town_star.desc: Small town at night with a bright star above a house

tomb_risen.desc: Empty tomb at sunrise, risen Jesus standing outside

meadow.desc: Empty green land with trees at dawn (creation, the world)

angry_crowd.desc: Angry leaders picking up stones in a courtyard

night_room.desc: Disciples in a lamp-lit courtyard at night with Jesus

storm_sea.desc: A ship in a stormy dark sea

tent_stars.desc: Abraham outside his tent at night under a sky full of stars (Abraham, God's promise, patriarchs, nomad life)

well_noon.desc: Jesus talking with a woman at a stone well in Samaria at midday (John 4, Samaritans, living water, outsiders welcomed)

lion_prowl.desc: A lion prowling across red rocks at dusk (1 Peter 5:8 "roaring lion", danger, temptation, Daniel, Samson)

rome_forum.desc: Roman city forum with columns, red banners and officials in togas, golden afternoon (Rome, emperors, Pilate, Roman historians, the year 336)

scribe_room.desc: A writer (Paul or a Gospel writer) writing a scroll by oil-lamp light, shelves of scrolls behind (who wrote the Bible, letters, Gospels, old manuscripts)

galilee_boat.desc: Fishermen in a wooden boat on a calm lake at dawn, hills behind (Sea of Galilee, Peter, disciples, calling, fishing)

sinai_mountain.desc: Moses with his staff before a great mountain wrapped in cloud and light (Sinai, the law, Ten Commandments, Deuteronomy; God shown only as light)

three_crosses.desc: Three empty wooden crosses on a hill outside Jerusalem at sunset (the cross, Jesus died for sins, Good Friday; no people, no violence)

shepherds_night.desc: Shepherds with their sheep in a field at night as an angel appears in bright light (Luke 2, Christmas, the good news, Bethlehem fields)

jerusalem_gate.desc: Jerusalem city wall and gate in the morning with travellers and elders (Jerusalem, Israel's leaders, Acts, arriving in the city)

modern_room.desc: Modern-day room at night: a young man on a sofa scrolling his phone, city lights in the window (today, "you", modern questions, social media)

world_families.desc: People of many nations and skin tones standing together on a hill at sunrise (all nations, "all the families of the earth", everyone, the gospel for the world)

moriah_walk.desc: Abraham and young Isaac walking up a mountain path at dawn, Isaac carrying firewood, a ram caught in a bush nearby (Genesis 22, Moriah, faith tested, "God will provide"; no knife, no violence)

cosmos_space.desc: Deep space: a galaxy, glowing nebula and planets drifting past (creation, "who made God?", the universe had a beginning, Psalm 19 "the heavens declare")

prodigal_return.desc: A father running with open arms to welcome his returning son on a country road at sunset (Luke 15, forgiveness, grace, coming home to God)

noah_ark.desc: Noah's ark resting on calm water after the flood, a rainbow in the sky and a dove flying (Genesis 6-9, the flood, God's promise, judgment and rescue)

moriah_climb.desc: Close shot: old Abraham and young Isaac climbing a rocky mountain path at dawn, Isaac carrying a bundle of firewood (Genesis 22, Moriah, the journey up)

abraham_stars.desc: Old Abraham outside his glowing tent at night, looking up at a sky full of stars, waiting for the promised son (Genesis 15, God's promise, Abraham waited decades)

isaac_asks.desc: Close two-shot on the mountain path: young Isaac with the firewood looks up and asks his father a question; Abraham looks down at him (Genesis 22:7-8, "where is the lamb?", "God will provide")

moriah_altar.desc: Mountain top: a stone altar with firewood, Abraham with arms raised and Isaac safe beside him as bright light pours down from heaven (Genesis 22:11-12, God stops Abraham; God shown only as light; no knife, no violence)

ram_thicket.desc: A ram caught by its horns in a thicket on the mountain top; Abraham and Isaac turn and see it, relieved (Genesis 22:13, "God will provide", the substitute; no violence)

temple_moriah.desc: Wide view: Jerusalem's gleaming temple on top of Mount Moriah above the city at sunrise (2 Chronicles 3:1, Solomon's temple, Moriah, Jerusalem)

jordan_john.desc: At the Jordan River: John the Baptist, standing by the water, points at Jesus walking toward him (John 1:29, "Behold! The Lamb of God")

cross_dusk.desc: A single empty wooden cross on a hill outside Jerusalem against a dramatic dusk sky, no people (God gave His own Son, Romans 8:32; the cross; no violence)

jesus_dawn.desc: The risen Jesus standing on a green hill at sunrise holding a lamb, warm light behind Him (Jesus the Lamb of God, risen, "God will provide", hope)

studio_putti.desc: A Renaissance painter's studio: an artist paints a canvas of chubby winged babies by a sunny window, more such paintings on the walls (where the cute baby angel image came from: Italian Renaissance art)

eden_gate.desc: The east of Eden: two tall shining cherubim, wings raised, stand on either side of the way to a glowing tree of life, a flaming sword turning in the air between them (Genesis 3:24; cherubim are mighty, not babies)

shepherds_fright.desc: Night fields near Bethlehem: shepherds and sheep cower, shielding their eyes, as an angel appears in blinding light above them (Luke 2:9, "they were greatly afraid")

tomb_angel.desc: Dawn at the empty tomb: an angel shining like lightning, clothes white as snow, sits on the rolled-away stone (Matthew 28:2-3)

guards_fall.desc: Two Roman soldiers at the tomb tremble and fall back on the ground in fear before a blinding light (Matthew 28:4, "the guards shook for fear"; no violence)

women_tomb.desc: Two women at the open tomb at sunrise listen with joy as a shining angel tells them "He is not here; for He is risen" (Matthew 28:5-6)

risen_road.desc: On a country road at sunrise the risen Jesus meets the overjoyed women, who run to Him (Matthew 28:8-9, Jesus alive, the greatest news)

letter_lamp.desc: Close shot: an early Christian writer at a desk writes a letter on a scroll by warm oil-lamp light, the word FAITH glowing faintly on the page (the letter to the Hebrews, the Bible defining faith)

wind_field.desc: A young man on a hilltop at golden hour, cloak and the tall grass blowing in a strong unseen wind, trees bending (you can't see the wind but you see what it does; things not seen, trust built on evidence)

thomas_doubt.desc: A lamp-lit room: excited disciples tell Thomas they have seen Jesus alive; Thomas stands with arms crossed, shaking his head, unconvinced (John 20:24-25)

room_jesus.desc: In the locked lamp-lit room the risen Jesus stands in soft light, holding out His open hands toward Thomas, who leans in amazed (John 20:26-27, "Reach your finger here, and look at My hands"; no wounds shown graphically)

thomas_worship.desc: Thomas, overwhelmed, lifts his hands to Jesus in worship as the other disciples watch (John 20:28, "My Lord and my God!")

hill_500.desc: Jesus on a sunny hillside seen by a huge crowd of hundreds of people at once, heads of the crowd in the blurred foreground (1 Corinthians 15:6, seen by over five hundred people)

path_dawn.desc: A young man of today walks along a lit path at sunrise toward Jesus, who waits with open arms (faith is not a leap in the dark; trusting Jesus, the One who showed up)

putti_canvas.desc: Close-up on the painter's canvas: chubby winged babies on clouds, brush strokes, warm window light (the cute baby angel image is from painters, not the Bible)
